purpose: Pillar-1 discipline registry. Every trust-verdict emitter (a code path that stamps a soundness-bearing label: KernelVerified / Proved / valid / verified / safe) in the trusted crates is classified here by BASIS. scripts/check_trust_verdict_emitters.py enforces: (1) no new UNCLASSIFIED verdict construction appears in an enforced crate, (2) kernel-rechecked entries actually call a kernel recheck primitive, (3) asserts-own-authority entries carry a // SOUNDNESS: comment, (4) the asserts-own-authority count only ratchets DOWN. Seeded from docs/PILLAR_1_TRUST_MAP.md (127-emitter audit; the 15 canonical entry points enumerated in map section 1, plus the equivalence-class summary). ENFORCEMENT SCOPE: only crates present in THIS repo (clean-kernel) are hard-scanned for new emitters; entries with repo:trust live in the separate ~/trust fork and are documented here for the honest full picture but enforced by that repo's own gate.

basis_legend.kernel-rechecked: every accept passes through the trusted kernel checker (infer_sort/check_type/is_def_eq/replay_and_verify/check_proof_strict); a false verdict is caught by the TCB.
basis_legend.fail-closed: emitter only ever WEAKENS an accept to Unknown/Err; unconfirmed input cannot become green.
basis_legend.deferred: soundness delegated to a named external sound prover + its strict certificate checker (not the clean-kernel).
basis_legend.honest-label: provenance/quality label that mints no soundness verdict.
basis_legend.asserts-own-authority: accepts on its own say-so with no kernel recheck at the boundary; sound only by a downstream backstop or caller discipline. REQUIRES a // SOUNDNESS: comment + a ratchet entry. Count ratchets DOWN only.

asserts_own_authority_ratchet.note: The five clean-kernel bypass primitives (map emitters 3,4,5,7,8). Post-G2 the value-less axiom-shaped smuggle (emitter 4) is caught by C1's symmetric infer_sort; post-G4 the trust-bearing overlay lane (emitter 7) is off extend_constants_unchecked onto the kernel-checked extend_constants_checked. The PRIMITIVES still exist (they remain callable, ratchet-gated to ~0 production proof-minting callers), so they stay classified asserts-own-authority here; the count ratchets DOWN as primitives are removed or hard-gated. Do not raise this number without a soundness review.

Identical Phase-1 gauntlet: infer_sort, in-Prop, check_type -> infer_type. Parity asserted by test_check_decl_readonly_matches_add_decl_verdict.

Absent it, returns Err(AxiomOnlyMisuse) instead of dropping the value. Sound path (Metamath two-pass, where PASS-2 re-verifies every proof) unaffected.

Sole production caller proof_commands.rs:522 is a read-only audit env (G3: now counted in data/unchecked_decl_ratchet.json add_decl_structural_production_sites, sound-by-isolation).

infer_sort(ind_type.type_ / ctor.type_), validate_inductive, check_positivity/nested. Recursors are kernel-CONSTRUCTED (no user authority). Residual: recursor well-formedness trusted from the generator (documented in the trust map residual TCB).

Remaining callers are sound-by-isolation scratch envs (merge_check.rs, closure_source.rs), tracked in data/unchecked_decl_ratchet.json.

emitters.justification: G4 hardened lane: validate_constant_info_structural (fvar/mvar/level-scope) unconditionally + infer_sort(type_) + check_type(value,type_) per record, UnknownConst-tolerant for legitimate forward/external refs. Any genuine typing failure is fatal (fail-closed).

validate_constant_info_structural (no dup-level-param/mvar/fvar/level-scope) but NO infer_sort/check_type. .olean/mathverse import boundary; stored Unverified; opt-in typecheck_constants_full; graduation re-checked via add_decl. Tracked in data/unchecked_decl_ratchet.json.

C1: fresh per-decl TypeChecker -> check_type(value,type_) re-verifies EVERY Theorem/Definition body from scratch, AND (G2 FIXED) infer_sort(type_) re-checks EVERY Axiom-kind type for well-formedness (symmetric across kinds). C2 pins axiom base vs golden; C3 trust-marker reachability; C4/C4' refutation; C5 exploits. is_sound ANDs all six.

Quality heuristic gated CLEAN_STRICT_PROOF_QUALITY, not a soundness gate. On failure only ROLLS BACK an already-type-checked insert; never accepts a term check_type rejected. Emits no unsound verdict.

add_decl(Theorem{..}) — the derivation term from the MM proof tree is routed through add_decl, which infer_sort+check_type's it; MM subst primitives are reducible kernel Definitions, fact discharged by Eq.refl the kernel EVALUATES. Tampered statement reduces to a different value => add_decl's type-check fails.

infer_type_with_cert (kernel) -> CertVerifier::replay_and_verify independently re-derives -> assert inferred==replayed else ReplayTypeMismatch -> cross_validate_with_micro. Every Ok gated on kernel infer.
MicroChecker::verify re-derives; structural type-eq vs kernel; disagreement => Err(Disagreement); unsupported => Ok(false) (SKIP, not pass). Never Ok(true) without an independent match.
replay_cert reconstructs expr; verify(cert,&expr) re-runs the typing derivation step-by-step vs env. Second independent leg of verify_expr; mismatch => CertError.

build() labels an entry KernelVerified only when it carries a CrossProjectCert; that label is ENFORCED at verification time by verify_single, which (a) guards that any KernelVerified manifest entry MUST carry a cross-project cert (else VerificationFailed) and (b) replays the cert through CertVerifier::verify (the replay_and_verify path) against the proof term — an independent kernel re-derivation. The build-time label alone mints no trust that verify_single does not re-check.

Fail-closed by construction: Proved only if strict_verdict==Verified && accept_for_consumer(Strict).is_ok(); every other arm => Unknown. UNSAT not trusted directly — ay's check_proof_strict (Alethe/LRAT) + optional Carcara crosscheck. Soundness reduces to ay's strict checker + formula translation, NOT clean-kernel (map gap G6). Enforced by the ~/trust repo gate.

Single user-facing chokepoint: require_assurance(SmtBacked) only WEAKENS Proved->Unknown. FLOOR-COLLISION gap G7: SmtBacked (order 2) == AssuranceLevel::Sound (order 2), so a self-authority Sound backend passes on its own analysis authority. G7 is the highest-leverage follow-up (see docs/PILLAR_1_TRUST_MAP.md). Enforced by the ~/trust repo gate.
